question: Rekha started walking from her office in the west direction. On traveling a distance of 5 m, she turns to the right and travels a distance of 2 m. She further turns to the right and travels a distance of 7.5 m. She then turns right at 135° and travels a distance of 15 m. In which direction is she facing now?
solution:
Given: 

Rekha started walking from her office in the west direction.

On traveling a distance of 5 m, she turns to the right and travels a distance of 2 m.

She further turns to the right and travels a distance of 7.5 m.

She then turns right at 135° and travels a distance of 15 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1edc0f322312761290de8fc5e422e75b6e80fdee77ad154730e4b603f4d2205c.png] 

Thus, Rekha is facing in the southwest direction.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
